WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, MIN(TRY_CAST(t.term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms t ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND t.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
leg_years AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, first_term_start,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start)::INTEGER + 31 as min_year,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start)::INTEGER + 49 as max_year
    FROM male_la_legislators
),
leg_year_range AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, unnest(generate_series(min_year, max_year)) as year_of_interest
    FROM leg_years
),
active_check AS (
    SELECT lyr.id_bioguide, lyr.year_of_interest,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t
               WHERE t.id_bioguide = lyr.id_bioguide
               AND TRY_CAST(t.term_start AS DATE) <= TRY_CAST(lyr.year_of_interest::VARCHAR || '-12-31' AS DATE)
               AND TRY_CAST(t.term_end AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST(lyr.year_of_interest::VARCHAR || '-12-31' AS DATE)
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_active
    FROM leg_year_range lyr
),
final_check AS (
    SELECT ac.id_bioguide, ac.year_of_interest, ml.first_term_start,
           ac.year_of_interest - (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ml.first_term_start)::INTEGER) as years_elapsed
    FROM active_check ac
    JOIN male_la_legislators ml ON ac.id_bioguide = ml.id_bioguide
    WHERE ac.is_active = 1
)
SELECT 
    years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM final_check
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
